title.zh-CN: 工作区与产出 · Project · Memory · 产物 · Computer Use
title.en-US: Workspace & output · Project · Memory · Artifacts · Computer Use

zh-CN: 工作区 Project：绑定目录 / 知识分区 / 默认 Agent·Skill·MCP，会话可归属项目
跨会话 Memory（全局 / Agent / 项目）与会话产物 Artifacts 面板
编码 Rules 注入 + 写文件 diff 审阅；设置页用量统计与全局规则
通知结果可续聊；轨迹侧栏子智能体编排看板与聊天卡片一致
Computer Use（默认关闭）：隐藏浏览器导航/点击/输入/读文/截图 + 系统打开链接/路径，强审批与域名白名单
工作台语音听写（Web Speech）；macOS 麦克风 entitlements
正式签名文档与 CI：mac 公证 / Win 可选 CSC；未签名包仍引导手动更新
en-US: Workspace Projects: bind folder / knowledge scope / default Agent·Skill·MCP; sessions can belong to a project
Cross-session Memory (global / agent / project) and session Artifacts panel
Coding Rules injection + write-file diff review; usage stats and global rules in Settings
Continue chats from notification results; trajectory subagent board matches in-chat cards
Computer Use (off by default): hidden browser navigate/click/type/read/screenshot + OS open URL/path, strong approval and host allowlist
Workbench voice dictation (Web Speech); macOS microphone entitlements
Signing docs & CI: mac notarize / optional Windows CSC; unsigned builds still guide manual updates

title.zh-CN: 信任感与闭环 · 工具可见 · 更新与导出
title.en-US: Trust & closure · tool visibility · updates & export

zh-CN: 聊天内展示工具步骤卡；体彩数据源明确可读写，减少「假只读」幻觉
设置可检查 GitHub 更新；知识引用可点跳转知识库
工具审批支持本会话始终允许；轨迹面板可展开/复制完整工具结果
长任务支持暂停/继续；崩溃后补写 interrupted checkpoint
子智能体卡片与会话父子标识；失败 turn / 工具可一键重试
会话导出 Markdown/PDF；知识库失败队列筛选与批量重建
定时 agent 任务改为无会话 ephemeral，结果进通知；历史会话删除更可靠
工作台顶栏面板菜单（轨迹/终端/记忆/产物）；macOS 签名/公证可选 CI 与文档
en-US: In-chat ToolStepsCard; lottery data source clearly read/write to cut fake read-only replies
In-app GitHub update check; knowledge citations deep-link into Knowledge
Session always-allow for tool approval; trajectory expand/copy full tool results
Pause/resume long turns; recover interrupted turns after crash
Subagent cards + parent/child session badges; retry failed turns/tools
Export session as Markdown/PDF; knowledge failure queue filter + batch re-embed
Scheduled agent jobs run ephemeral (no workbench sessions); more reliable session delete
Workbench Panels menu (trajectory/terminal/memory/artifacts); optional macOS signing/notarize CI docs

title.zh-CN: 体彩智能体 · 爬虫工具 · 会话排队
title.en-US: Lottery agent · crawl tool · message queue

zh-CN: 新增体彩分析智能体：预置本地 SQLite 数据源与 Skill，不依赖专用代码模块
打包安装后自动内置 lottery.db；若本机已有历史爬取数据会自动迁移
数据源能力增强：列表/查询工具、表结构提示、旧列名自动兼容
联网检索更稳：Bing/Google 超时回退 DuckDuckGo，超时与抓取提示优化
工具箱新增网页爬虫页：导出与调度联动
工作台会话支持发送队列：回复进行中可继续提问排队，支持单条移除与清空
创建智能体时可绑定数据源；内置 Skill 覆盖数据流水线与体彩数据源用法
en-US: New sports-lottery agent: preset local SQLite data source + Skill, no lottery-specific code modules
Packaged installs ship lottery.db; existing local crawl data migrates automatically
Stronger data-source tools: list/query, schema hints, legacy column-name rewrite
More reliable web lookup: Bing/Google fall back to DuckDuckGo with longer timeouts
New crawl tool page with export helpers and schedule hooks
Workbench send queue: queue follow-ups while a reply streams; remove one item or clear all
Create-agent flow can bind data sources; built-in Skills for data pipeline and lottery DB usage

title.zh-CN: 调度 · 数据源 · 知识库分区树

zh-CN: 新增定时调度：卡片式任务、周期/窗口执行，结果可投递收件箱、钉钉与邮件
设置页数据源：卡片管理、按需安装驱动、连接测试；覆盖常见数据库（含 Redis / ClickHouse 等）
模型与 API 改为卡片式管理，添加与编辑体验更清晰
知识库分区支持树形上下级：新建/重命名/删除；删除时可选一并清理文档或移到默认分区
父分区文档数计入全部子分区；分区侧栏树形样式与内联新建子分区
运势/股票独立页收敛到工作台智能体；收件箱与通知通道完善
预置官方开源 MCP（Memory / Sequential Thinking / Filesystem 等），设置页改为卡片式管理
智能体支持删除；设置新增「智能体」管理页
侧栏文案改为「智能体指挥中枢」；通知入口移至设置下方；设置默认进入「常规」
音视频工具页布局与响应式修正；工作台去掉对话框内重复的「收起会话」
en-US: Schedules: card tasks with once/daily/interval/window runs; deliver to inbox, DingTalk, and email
Settings data sources: card UI, on-demand drivers, connection test; common DBs including Redis / ClickHouse
Models & API redesigned as cards for clearer add/edit flows
Knowledge collections as a tree: create/rename/delete; delete can cascade docs or move them to default
Parent doc counts include all descendants; cleaner tree UI with inline sub-collection create
Fortune/Stocks standalone pages folded into workbench agents; inbox and notify channels improved
Seed official open-source MCPs (Memory / Sequential Thinking / Filesystem, etc.) with a card-based settings UI
Delete custom agents; new Agents management page in Settings
Sidebar tag → Agent Command Hub; Notifications under Settings; Settings opens on General by default
Audio toolkit layout/responsive fixes; remove duplicate “Hide sessions” from the chat header

title.zh-CN: 万年历 · 班休标注与布局修复

zh-CN: 月历标注法定节假日与调休：休息日显示「休」，调休上班显示「班」
日详情展示上班/休息/调休状态（含节假日名称）
当前时刻翻页时钟按容器自适应缩放，避免撑破内容区
修复万年历页横向滚动条与右侧贴边问题
版本变更记录改为 config/changelog.json，发版时只需更新该配置
en-US: Month grid marks CN statutory rest days (休) and makeup workdays (班)
Day detail shows work / rest / makeup status with holiday names
Flip clock scales to its container so it no longer overflows
Fix calendar page horizontal scrollbar and edge-flush layout
Changelog now lives in config/changelog.json for easier releases

title.zh-CN: 工作台 · 联网对话与供应商模型
title.en-US: Workbench · live web chat & provider models

zh-CN: 直连会话与智能体拆分：直连默认聊天；股票/运势/自定义智能体才带领域人设与工具链
工作台「联网」能力（默认开启）：搜索网页、解析公司代码、拉取行情后再回答；关闭即为纯模型
对话流式输出：边生成边渲染；工具过程不塞进主气泡，完整轨迹仍可在「轨迹」面板查看
模型与 API：按供应商管理；添加模型可用勾选声明图/视频等输入输出能力（不必再单独填媒体模型框）
对话与智能体创建时，模型选择按供应商分组
股票工具增强：中文公司名检索、A 股东财行情回退、网页抓取等，避免仅靠训练记忆误判上市状态
思考态动画与更清晰的工作台能力栏
打包产物：macOS DMG、Linux AppImage/deb；Windows 提供便携 zip
en-US: Split direct chat from agents: plain chat by default; Fortune/Stocks/custom agents keep persona + tools
Workbench “Web” toggle (on by default): search, resolve tickers, and fetch quotes before answering; off = raw model
Token streaming in the composer bubble; tool details stay in Trajectory, not the main chat
Models & API: per-provider configs; add models with modality checkboxes (image/video in/out) instead of separate media fields
Chat and agent pickers group models by provider
Stronger stock tooling: CN name lookup, Eastmoney quote fallback, page fetch — fewer false “unlisted” answers
Thinking indicator and a clearer capability bar
Packaging: macOS DMG, Linux AppImage/deb; Windows portable zip
